title: Slack Webhook URL, Jenkins Credential로 등록
markdown: ### Slack Webhook URL, Jenkins Credential로 등록 --- 1. Slack App 설정 → Incoming Webhooks 활성화 - Slack App 설정 → Incoming Webhooks 활성화 - Webhook URL 생성 - ex) https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00000000/B00000000/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX 1. Jenkins Credentials 등록 - Jenkins → Manage Jenkins → Credentials ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8084-bc79-d8feca0096be/c70948806e67af7b.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8084-bc79-d8feca0096be/e5348012cb7e10da.webp) - Domains, (global) - Add Credentials ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8084-bc79-d8feca0096be/a2c262483b852d8e.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8084-bc79-d8feca0096be/2adfd32e9cb4ec64.webp) - Credential 입력 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/208eda9b-0fe1-8084-bc79-d8feca0096be/344322c050d579af.webp) 1. 사용 ```groovy . . . post { success { script { def logContent = readFile('deploy-check.log') if (logContent.contains("APPLICATION FAILED TO START")) { error("🚨 Spring Boot 애플리케이션이 포트 충돌 등으로 인해 시작 실패했습니다.") } } withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL', variable: 'SLACK_URL')]) { sh """ curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \\ --data '{"text":"✅ *배포 성공* : ${JOB_NAME} #${BUILD_NUMBER}"}' \\ \$SLACK_URL """ } } failure { withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL', variable: 'SLACK_URL')]) { sh """ curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \\ --data '{"text":"❌ *배포 실패* : ${JOB_NAME} #${BUILD_NUMBER}"}' \\ \$SLACK_URL """ } } } } ``` - withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL', variable: 'SLACK_URL')]) - 등록한 Slack Webhook을 credentialsId로 가져와 변수로 등록해 사용한다.
